name: Cool Kingdom 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Cool Kingdom is a strategic decision-making game that places you in the role of a king tasked with guiding your realm through perilous times. As the ruler, every decision you make matters, whether it's a simple "yes" or "no." It has profound effects on critical resources like population, happiness, wealth, and authority.
